name: u214b_write_string_at_fwd_set_attr
purpose: As 026D with an attribute parameter stored in DS:AAB2

name: u214b_unpack_screen_to_buffer
purpose: Thin wrapper: calls the unpacker 0147 with source (second arg) and destination far pointer (first arg, a pointer variable)

name: u214b_draw_centered_message_line
purpose: Centres a text message (padding with 0xFE via 0018, Move) and draws it at a row with attributes, with literal '? (Y/N)' tested by a Pos; marks the Y/N parts; screen text

name: u214b_message_wait_key
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Saves bottom screen line, shows the message via 0350 with ' PRESS ANY KEY ', waits for a key (0983) and restores the line

name: u214b_ask_yes_no
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Shows a prompt line with '? (Y/N)', reads a key (set of allowed keys, 09A7), returns true if upper-cased key is 'Y'; restores the line

name: u214b_unpack_screen_796a_to_back
purpose: Unpacks the packed screen at DS:796A into the buffer whose far pointer is DS:A96E (back/offscreen screen)

name: u214b_unpack_screen_row_record
purpose: (row word): DS:79A4 := (row - 1) * 0x50 + 1, then unpacks the packed screen that word heads (the stream follows it at DS:79A6) into the buffer DS:A96E points at, with 0329

name: u214b_save_bottom_line
purpose: Copies 0xA0 bytes (one text row) at row offset 0xF00 of the screen buffer DS:A96A to a save area at DS:AA04

name: u214b_restore_bottom_line
purpose: Copies 0xA0 bytes from the save area DS:AA04 back to row offset 0xF00 of the screen buffer DS:A96A

name: u214b_hide_cursor
purpose: INT 10h (via 235C:000B Intr, int number 0x10) AH=2 set cursor position to column 1, row 0x1A (off screen), hiding the text cursor

name: u214b_lcg_step
purpose: one step of the linear congruential generator (the game's random stream)

name: u214b_random_1_to_n
purpose: a random value 1..n from the generator whose seed pointer is at DS:A978

name: u214b_random_is_one
purpose: Draws random 1..n from DS:A978 and returns whether it equals 1 (chance 1 in n)

name: u214b_random_coin_flip
purpose: Draws random 1..2 from DS:A978 and returns whether it equals 1 (a coin flip)

name: u214b_key_pressed
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Keypressed: INT 16h AH=1 via 235C:000B, returns true when zero flag clear (no ZF bit 0x40)

name: u214b_video_mode_setup
purpose: Reads BIOS video mode at 0040:0049; mono (7) gives segment B000, else forces mode 3 and uses B800; stores text screen pointer DS:A96A and a mono flag DS:A964

name: u214b_shell_to_dos
purpose: Shell to DOS: saves screen, shows 'Type EXIT to return', reads COMSPEC, executes COMMAND.COM, shows memory/file error messages, restores screen and cursor

name: u214b_read_key
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Waits for a key (INT 16h AH=0 via Intr), maps cursor-pad scancodes to codes >0x80 (non-ASCII key mapping), stores in DS:A976/DS:A977; handles a pushed-back key DS:79AE; a code 0xA3 triggers screen print 0B4D

name: u214b_wait_key_and_clear
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Calls the key read 08DD, then clears DS:A976

name: u214b_push_back_key
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Stores a key code in DS:A976 and sets the pushed-back flag DS:79AE so the next 08DD returns it without waiting

name: u214b_wait_key_in_set
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Copies a 32-byte set from a far pointer and loops 08DD until the key code is a member of the set

name: u214b_number_to_string
purpose: (long value, var s: string[20]): Str(value:0) into a local through 23E4:12F6, then s := local clipped to 20 by 23E4:0644

name: u214b_fatal_message_halt
purpose: Shows a message with press-any-key (04F8) then calls a 23E4 routine (probably Halt)

name: u214b_get_mem_zeroed
purpose: Checks memory with 23E4:03D0 (MaxAvail), shows 'Insufficient memory to run program' if short, GetMem via 23E4:0329, zero-fills the block with 0018

name: u214b_printer_status
purpose: INT 17h AH=2 via Intr (printer status); status bits 0x40 / 0x08 give code 1 or 2, shows 'Printer ' message line and returns true when the printer is ready

name: u214b_print_screen
purpose: Prints the 80x25 text screen to the printer file (text file calls in 23E4), chars outside 0x20..0x80 become spaces; 'Printing...' message; triggered by key code 0xA3 in 08DD

name: u214b_set_test_bit
purpose: Returns bit (k-1) of a byte/word for element k (Pascal set membership test, shift right and mask); F010's tactic sets (country +0x2D, player +0xF) are read with it

name: u214b_set_include_bit
purpose: Sets bit k-1 of a byte for Pascal set element k (Include)

name: u214b_set_exclude_bit
purpose: Clears bit k-1 of a byte for Pascal set element k (Exclude)

name: u214b_set_assign_bit
purpose: Sets or clears bit k-1 depending on a boolean argument (calls 0C79 or 0CA1); includes or excludes by value, as 1771:4B61's third state uses it (F010)

name: u214b_set_toggle_bit
purpose: Toggles bit k-1 of a byte (xor), set element toggle; the team-tactics screen 1771:1981 toggles an element of +0x2D with it (F010)

name: u214b_min_longint
purpose: Returns the smaller of two 32-bit signed integers

name: u214b_max_longint
purpose: Signed 32-bit maximum of two stack-passed longs: compares signed high words, then unsigned low words; returns the selected long in DX:AX (retf 8)

name: u214b_blink_cursor_wait_key
purpose: Near, nested: loops until a key is pressed (0723); meanwhile toggles one screen cell's colours on BIOS tick count 0040:006C divided by 3 parity (blinking cell); restores the cell

name: u214b_edit_line_redraw
purpose: Nested helper of the line editor 1086: redraws the input field (text, padding, scroll via uppercase conversion 19B2) at the field's position

name: u214b_edit_line_store_char
purpose: Nested helper of 1086: stores a character into the edit string at the cursor (insert shifts the rest, else overwrite), updates length byte

name: u214b_edit_string_input
purpose: Text-line input editor: cursor keys, Home/End, backspace, Esc restores original, insert/overwrite toggle, word jumps, max length; reads keys via 08DD, draws via 0E41

name: u214b_exit_proc_restore_screen
purpose: Exit procedure (address stored at DS:7B52/7B54 by 206A): resets the text file, shows the exit/message and restores the saved screen with attribute 0x19 after unpacking

name: u214b_fill_back_attr_70
purpose: Writes attribute 0x70 (reverse video) into N cells of the back buffer DS:A96E at column/row; highlight bar

name: u214b_menu_move_byte_clamp
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Updates a byte selection from the key in DS:A976: home/end keys set 1 or max, up/down codes step with clamping at both ends

name: u214b_menu_move_byte_wrap
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Like 13F6 for a byte selection but up/down codes wrap around (1 to max, max to 1)

name: u214b_menu_move_word_clamp
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Like 13F6 but for a 16-bit selection variable: clamp at ends, home/end to 1 or max

name: u214b_menu_move_word_wrap
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Like 1452 for a 16-bit selection variable: up/down wrap, other keys go to 14AC

name: u214b_menu_read_key_and_move
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Restores the screen from the back buffer (4000 bytes), reads a key (08DD) and moves a selection with 1507

name: u214b_set_list_position_pair
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Nested helper of 15B1: stores two 16-bit values (list top and cursor) through two pointers of the parent frame

name: u214b_list_scroll_by_key
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Scrolling list navigation: down/up arrows, page up/down, home/end update list top and cursor within the visible page and the item count

name: u214b_message_if_flag
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): Copies a message string and, if the flag argument is nonzero, shows it with the press-any-key box (04F8); returns the flag

name: u214b_unpack_screen_7aec
purpose: Unpacks the packed screen at DS:7AEC into the screen buffer DS:A96A

name: u214b_report_dos_file_error
purpose: Looks at DOS error code DS:A965 and shows its text (illegal file name or file not found, path not found, read only/hidden, no such drive, others), asks to retry (Y/N) via 0566, else halts or returns

name: u214b_pascal_to_asciiz
purpose: Copies a Pascal string into a buffer and terminates it with a zero byte (DOS path string)

name: u214b_dos_result_to_error
purpose: After an int 21h call: if carry set DS:A965 = error code in AX and handle DS:AAA4 = 0, else DS:A965 = 0 and DS:AAA4 = handle

name: u214b_dos_close_handle
purpose: DOS call (235C:0000 MsDos) with AH=3Eh close file for handle DS:AAA4 if open

name: u214b_dos_open_or_create
purpose: Copies a name string, converts to ASCIIZ (19B3), calls DOS (AH/AL passed in: 3C00 create, 3D02 open) via 235C:0000, records result with 19F4; name equal to a literal sets error 2

name: u214b_dos_write_checked
purpose: DOS write (AH=40h) of N bytes from a buffer to handle DS:AAA4; returns true if no carry and all bytes written, else error 0x65 in DS:A965

name: u214b_dos_read_file
purpose: DOS read (AH=3Fh) of N bytes into a buffer from handle DS:AAA4; stores bytes read in DS:A967, error code in DS:A965 on carry

name: u214b_dos_create_file
purpose: Creates a file by name: calls 1A5F with AX=3C00 (DOS create); returns true if DS:A965 = 0

name: u214b_dos_open_file_rw
purpose: Opens a file by name: calls 1A5F with AX=3D02 (DOS open read/write); returns true if DS:A965 = 0

name: u214b_dos_drive_not_cd
purpose: DOS call AH=19h (get current drive); returns true when the drive code is not 2 or 3 (outside C: and D:)

name: u214b_get_date
purpose: Calls 235C:006C (Dos GetDate-style) writing the year to DS:A9FD and discarding month and day

name: u214b_wrap_add_in_range
purpose: Adds a signed delta to a value and wraps it around inside the range [lo, hi] (cyclic increment/decrement)

name: u214b_wrap_add_in_range_byte
purpose: Byte wrapper of 1C86: wraps a byte variable by a delta inside [lo, hi]

name: u214b_calibrate_delay
purpose: Counts loop passes during one BIOS tick (0040:006C), divides by 55 and stores at DS:A9FF (delay calibration)

name: u214b_delay_ms
purpose: Calibrated busy-wait: param_1 times a loop of [DS:A9FF] counts (per millisecond)

name: u214b_sound_toggle_mute
purpose: Turns the speaker off (1E8D) and flips the sound-disabled flag DS:A9FC

name: u214b_speaker_on
purpose: If sound enabled (DS:A9FC = 0): out 43h,B6h (PIT channel 2 square wave) and sets port 61h bits 0 and 1 (gate and speaker on)

name: u214b_speaker_off
purpose: If sound enabled: clears port 61h bits 0 and 1 (speaker off)

name: u214b_beep_tone_delay
purpose: Sets a tone with 1EBC, delays param_1 ms with 1E09, then speaker off (one beep)

name: u214b_speaker_set_frequency
purpose: Speaker routine: turns speaker on and writes a 16-bit divisor (from a 23E4 helper) to PIT port 42h low then high byte

name: u214b_play_note
purpose: Plays a note: note number plus transposition DS:7968 reduced mod 12 into a PIT divisor by real-number (23E4 float) arithmetic, writes it to port 42h, then delays param*DS:7966 ms

name: u214b_play_jingle
purpose: Speaker on, repeats a two-note pattern (notes 9 and 7) a count times via 1EF1 with tempo DS:7966 = 1, then speaker off

name: u214b_clamp_int
purpose: Clamps an integer variable into [lo, hi] (16-bit)

name: u214b_clamp_byte
purpose: Clamps a byte variable into [lo, hi] (signed char compare)

name: u214b_unit_init
purpose: Unit start-up: reads the exe name/args (009C), sets sound flag DS:A9FC=1, video setup (0755), calibration (1DA7), allocates two 4000-byte screen buffers (A96E, A972), hides the cursor, sets seed pointer DS:A978 = DS:7B62, sets ExitProc DS:7B52 = 214B:136B, reads the date (1C63)

name: dos_msdos
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): pops return and args, sets AL=21h, re-pushes, falls into 235C:000B: MsDos(var regs) wrapper; the physical return frame moves by -2 bytes and the shared tail is retf 6 (effective caller argument pop 4)

name: dos_intr
purpose: T74 (Python port in runtime/original_match/port/menus.py): loads regs record (AX,BX,CX,DX,BP,SI,DI,DS,ES) and calls the interrupt vector chosen by byte param from IVT at 0000:n*4; Intr(num, regs); the IVT handler returns through IRET to 0045, and the continuation stores the ten-word register/flags record before retf 6

name: dos_store_registers
purpose: continuation of Intr: stores AX,BX,CX,DX,BP,SI,DI,DS,ES,flags into the caller's Registers record after the interrupt

name: dos_get_date
purpose: INT 21h AH=2Ah; AL -> weekday, DL day, DH month, CX year via 4 var params; GetDate

name: dos_set_date
purpose: INT 21h AH=2Bh (set date, args via stack regs); SetDate

name: dos_get_time
purpose: INT 21h AH=2Ch; DL hundredths, DH second, CL minute, CH hour via 4 var params; GetTime

name: dos_set_time
purpose: INT 21h AH=2Dh (set time); SetTime

name: dos_find_first
purpose: copies Pascal string path (max 79 chars) to ASCIIZ, INT 21h AH=1Ah set DTA, AH=4Eh find first, then 235C:0136 (sets DosError; copies name)

name: dos_find_next
purpose: INT 21h AH=1Ah set DTA, AH=4Fh find next, then 235C:0136; FindNext

name: dos_find_result
purpose: if no carry: converts DTA name (at +1Eh) to a Pascal string; stores AX (0 on success) in DS:AAA6 (DosError); helper for FindFirst/FindNext

name: dos_exec
purpose: copies path (max 79) and command tail (max 126, CR terminated), saves SS:SP in DS:AAA8/AAAA, INT 21h AH=29h parse FCB twice, AH=4Bh exec (AX=4B00h), AH=4Dh wait for return code; sets DS:AAA6 (DosError); Exec(path, cmdline)

name: dos_get_env
purpose: upper-cases Pascal string name (max 31), appends '=', scans the environment block at ES:0 for it, returns the value as Pascal string; GetEnv

name: crt_unit_init
purpose: CRT unit initialisation: calls 2382:0030 (video detect), 2382:032E twice (AssignCrt-style, at DS:AAC0 and DS:ABC0) then System 23E4:13E2/13E7 (Reset/Rewrite-like); the two text-file variables Input and Output

name: crt_init_video
purpose: reads video mode via 2382:0608 (INT 10h), if not 7 and above 3 calls 2382:0099, then 00E7; ends in Ghidra's endless loop (listing trailing code not decoded)

name: crt_set_video_mode
purpose: clears bit0 of BIOS byte 0040:0087 (ABS 0487), forces mode 3 unless 7 or at most 3, INT 10h; if rows nonzero, further INT 10h calls and sets bit0 when the char is '*' (EGA/VGA cursor emulation or 43/50-line fix)

name: crt_init_window_state
purpose: INT 10h calls (mode, cursor); fills CRT variables DS:AAAF (CheckSnow-like flag), AAB0, AABA (window max X/Y, 0x18 = row 24), AAAE, AAB4 (WindMin=0), AAB6 (WindMax)

name: crt_exit_restore
purpose: if DS:AABE set: clears it, drains the keyboard buffer via INT 16h AH=1/AH=0 until empty, writes CR/LF via 047B/0474, raises INT 23h (Ctrl-Break), resets video via 0099/00E7, sets DS:AAB2=DS:AABC (TextAttr from saved)

name: crt_text_mode
purpose: far routine: set video mode 0099 then 00E7 then DS:AAB2 = DS:AABC; TextMode(mode) shape

name: crt_goto_xy
purpose: far, params (x,y): bound-check against WindMin/WindMax (DS:AAB4/AAB6) then call 04FC (INT 10h AH=2 set cursor); GotoXY

name: crt_compare_bytes_loop
purpose: repe scasb-like loop comparing AL to ES:[DI] CX times; Pascal helper fragment (followed by 70 bytes of undecoded data: sound/Delay timing, 8253 port 42h/43h/61h code)

name: crt_read_key
purpose: INT 16h AH=0 (wait key) with DS:AABD pending-scancode buffer (extended key second byte), then calls 0145; ReadKey

name: crt_assign_crt
purpose: far, one pointer param: fills a Pascal TextRec (mode D7B0 = fmClosed-style, buffer size 0x80, buffer ptr at +0x80, handlers at 9000:0359, +0x30 byte 0); AssignCrt/text-file setup

name: crt_read_line
purpose: far, TextRec param: line editor reading keys via 030C, handling BS(8), ^S(0x13), ^D(4), ^F(6), ^Z(0x1A), Enter(0xD) with echo via 047B, fills buffer, appends CR LF; CRT text-file read (ReadLn) input handler

name: crt_write_crlf
purpose: writes CR (0xD) then LF (0xA) via 047B then 04F5/04D4/04FC

name: crt_write_char
purpose: AL char: get cursor (04F5, INT 10h AH=3), handles BEL(7), BS(8), CR(0xD), LF(0xA), else writes via INT 10h and advances/wraps, set cursor 04FC

name: crt_scroll_check
purpose: compares cursor row (DH+1) to DS:AAB6 high byte (WindMax Y), calls INT 10h (scroll up) when beyond

name: crt_get_cursor
purpose: mov ah,3; xor bh,bh; jmp 0608: INT 10h AH=3 read cursor position

name: crt_set_cursor
purpose: mov ah,2; xor bh,bh; jmp 0608: INT 10h AH=2 set cursor position

name: crt_int10
purpose: INT 10h stub (callers set AH, others); used everywhere in the unit

name: sys_init_0000
purpose: System start-up: sets stack/heap vars at DS:7B34..7B5C, 18x INT 21h (AH=35 get vector), then assigns+resets Input (1372,13E2) and assigns+rewrites Output (1372,13E7)

name: sys_halt_00D8
purpose: Halt: sets ExitCode=AX and ErrorAddr=0, closes Input/Output (143B), restores 18 vectors (INT 21h AH=25), prints 'Runtime error' text if error addr set, ends with INT 21h AH=4Ch

name: sys_print_cs_asciiz_0194
purpose: Prints a NUL-terminated string at CS:BX one char at a time via 01D6

name: sys_print_dec3_01A2
purpose: Prints AL as 3 decimal digits (divides by 100, 10 via 01AE), used for the runtime error number

name: sys_print_dec_digit_01AE
purpose: AL/CL as one decimal digit (adds '0') printed via 01D6, remainder left in AL

name: sys_print_hex_word_01BC
purpose: Prints AX as 4 hex digits (high byte via 01C3, then low byte)

name: sys_print_hex_byte_01C3
purpose: Prints AL as 2 hex digits (high nibble then 01CE)

name: sys_print_hex_nibble_01CE
purpose: Converts low nibble in AL to ASCII hex ('0'-'9','A'-'F') and prints via 01D6

name: sys_put_char_dos_01D6
purpose: INT 21h AH=06h: direct console output of the char in AL (DL)

name: sys_ioresult_0207
purpose: Returns DS:7B60 and zeroes it (xchg with 0): IOResult

name: sys_move_025D
purpose: Forward byte copy of count bytes from source to dest pointers: Move (Pascal Move(Source, Dest, Count): the first pushed pointer is the source, ss:[bx+0xA] to DS:SI, the second the destination, ss:[bx+6] to ES:DI; the decompiled call lists (count, destination, source))

name: sys_long_mul_0279
purpose: Low 32 bits of DX:AX times BX:CX (CX low, BX high), formed from partial 16-bit products; leaves SI and DI as copies of AX and DX and BX and CX as cross terms

name: sys_long_div_0294
purpose: Signed 32-bit shift-subtract division (33 iterations); divisor 0 jumps to runtime error 00D1; quotient in DX:AX, remainder left in registers

name: sys_getmem_0329
purpose: Calls heap allocate 041D; on carry runtime error AX=00CBh (203 heap overflow); returns pointer in DX:AX/BX:CX: GetMem

name: sys_freemem_0341
purpose: Calls heap release 04D8 with size and pointer; on carry runtime error 00CCh (204 invalid pointer): FreeMem

name: sys_memavail_038C
purpose: Walks the heap free list (DS:7B48) accumulating block sizes: total free memory, MemAvail-like

name: sys_maxavail_03D0
purpose: Walks the heap free list (DS:7B48) keeping the largest block: MaxAvail-like

name: sys_heap_alloc_041D
purpose: Heap allocator: searches free list (DS:7B48) for a block big enough, shrinks/removes it, else extends the heap top (DS:7B44/7B46) or calls the HeapError function at DS:7B4E; CF on failure

name: sys_heap_free_04D8
purpose: Heap release: validates the block lies in the heap, inserts it into the sorted free list, merging neighbours (calls 058B/05AF), or lowers heap top

name: sys_heap_free_list_pop_058B
purpose: Moves free list base (DS:7B48) back by 8 bytes when still above heap top: grow free-list table

name: sys_heap_free_list_remove_05AF
purpose: Copies a 4-word free-list entry and advances the free list base by 4 words: drop an entry

name: sys_heap_free_list_check_05C4
purpose: Tests whether the free list (DS:7B48/7B4C) is empty; no other effect shown

name: sys_ptr_to_para_060D
purpose: Splits a byte count into paragraphs and remainder (AX>>4, AX&0F) for heap arithmetic

name: sys_para_to_bytes_061B
purpose: Combines paragraph:offset back into a 32-bit byte count (AX | DX<<4, DX>>12)

name: sys_str_store_062A
purpose: Copies a Pascal string (length byte + chars), no length limit: string assignment

name: sys_str_store_max_0644
purpose: Copies a Pascal string truncating to a maximum length given in param 1: string assignment to a shorter string var

name: sys_str_copy_0676
purpose: Copy(s, index, count): index clamped to >=1, count limited to remaining chars, result length byte then chars

name: sys_str_concat_06B7
purpose: Appends one Pascal string to another, length saturating at 255: string concatenation

name: sys_str_pos_06E3
purpose: Searches for a substring in a Pascal string (repe cmpsb scan), returns 1-based index or 0: Pos

name: sys_str_compare_072F
purpose: Compares two Pascal strings over the shorter length (repe cmpsb, result in flags): string comparison

name: sys_char_to_str_075A
purpose: Builds a 1-char Pascal string (length 1, char in byte 2)

name: sys_str_insert_0787
purpose: Insert(src, s, index): Copy(s,1,idx-1)+src+Copy(s,idx,255) built in two 256-byte temporaries then stored with max length

name: sys_str_delete_07DB
purpose: Delete(s, index, count): Copy(s,1,idx-1)+Copy(s,idx+count,255) in temporaries, stored back; no-op if count<=0

name: sys_set_expand_0831
purpose: Builds a 32-byte set: zero-fills a leading offset, copies a small set's bytes, zero-fills the rest

name: sys_set_compact_08BF
purpose: (word bh:bl, dest, src): copies bl bytes of the source from byte bh on to the destination (a set held in fewer bytes)

name: sys_set_bit_mask_08DF
purpose: Pascal set membership test: computes the address of byte n>>3 of the 32-byte set argument and tests bit n&7 (test byte ptr es:[bx+di], al, seg_23E4_01.asm:1065), returning the result in ZF - ZF SET means NOT a member; callers branch je (skip) on the non-member side

name: sys_set_union_0900
purpose: ORs 16 words (32 bytes) of one set into another: set union

name: sys_real_sub_098B
purpose: 6-byte Real subtraction: flips sign bit of second operand (xor DI,8000h) then falls into the addition 098F

name: sys_real_add_098F
purpose: 6-byte Real addition: exponent in AL/CL, align mantissas by shifting, add or subtract by sign, normalize and round

name: sys_real_mul_0A52
purpose: 6-byte Real multiplication: adds exponents (bias 7F7Fh), multiplies mantissas, normalizes, underflow gives 0

name: sys_real_div_0B57
purpose: 6-byte Real division: bitwise shift-subtract mantissa division, exponent subtract; zero numerator gives 0

name: sys_real_compare_0BCE
purpose: 6-byte Real compare helper: tests sign difference then calls magnitude compare 0BE5

name: sys_real_compare_mag_0BE5
purpose: 6-byte Real magnitude compare (cmp AL,CL exponents then mantissa words DX/DI, BX/SI)

name: sys_long_to_real_0BF8
purpose: Converts a signed 32-bit integer (DX:AX) to 6-byte Real: abs, left-shift until top bit set to normalize

name: sys_real_to_long_0C37
purpose: Converts a 6-byte Real to a 32-bit integer by shifting mantissa by exponent; CH nonzero selects rounding, else truncation; out of range gives carry

name: sys_real_add_chk_0C93
purpose: Far entry: calls real add 098F, on carry (overflow) runtime error 00D1

name: sys_real_mul_chk_0CA5
purpose: Far entry: calls real multiply 0A52, on carry runtime error 00D1

name: sys_real_div_chk_0CAB
purpose: Far entry: divisor exponent CL=0 gives runtime error 00D1, else calls real divide 0B57, carry gives error

name: sys_long_to_real_far_0CB9
purpose: Far entry: calls long-to-real conversion 0BF8

name: sys_real_to_long_chk_0CC5
